svg.aria-label: Wiring diagram: Li-ion battery with fuse and switch; branch to a TPS63020 that supplies 3.3 V to the 3V3 pin of the ESP32-S3 Super Mini; separate branch with a PTC to two 2-wire 5 V fans, each switched by a 2N2222 NPN transistor (470 Ω on the base, 10 kΩ to ground) from GPIO5 and GPIO6 (the yellow and blue wires are insulated); and the display sniffer on GPIO1 and GPIO4.
svg.text: C2 and C3 soldered next to the 3V3 pin
Q1, D1, R1 and R2 near the ESP; C5 at the fan terminals.
Q1 emitter: own wire to the battery − terminal (GND_P).
Q2, D2, R3 and R4 near the ESP; C6 at the fan terminals.
Q2 emitter: own wire to the battery − terminal (GND_P).
The actual order of the 6 pins of J1 follows the silkscreen
of the display board; only the 4 that matter are drawn here.
Both 470 Ω and D3 go next to the ESP.
